extension.root_lifting_lemma: If a candidate y has the correct inverse-square base coordinate, x*(y*x) is the exact inverse square in the additive extension.

consequences: The conjecture that cubing the square map is the identity is false, already at order 15.
The proposed replacement period 12 is false at order 45.
These statements do not refute general uniform division terms.
The observed tower is not yet a proved infinite family.

search_notes: Prover9, Vampire, and Twee did not prove the stabilization in 180-second runs.

Mace4 exhausted the normalized order-10 and order-12 searches with a prescribed 3-cycle through 0; order-15 and order-18 searches with a prescribed 12-cycle timed out. These are restricted searches, not global theorems.
Candidate survives all additive cocycles over the eight repository seeds and the 45-element lift for p=2,3,5,7,11,13, and over the 135-element lift for p=3.
Candidate survives tested normalized three-colour scalar bundles through p=19, and upper triangular matrix extensions through p=13.
An F3-valued additive cocycle on the 405-element model refutes it at order 1215. These earlier surviving tests did not amount to a proof.
